name: Animated List
mechanism: Ordered rows use staggered appearance, selection emphasis and scroll-edge gradients; upstream exposes selection and arrow navigation.
adaptation: Original wordless row geometry drifts in a seeded staggered wave, with geometric tokens rather than selectable list items or fabricated app text.

name: Magic Bento
mechanism: Asymmetric bento cards combine border glow, a shared spotlight, particles and optional tilt/magnetism.
adaptation: Six original unequal panels use frame-driven lifts and orbiting accent points; all content stays abstract and decorative behind the semantic layer.

name: Tilted Card
mechanism: Pointer-relative rotation springs tilt a card in two axes, with optional hover scale, image and overlay content.
adaptation: An original projected quadrilateral and geometric inlay rotate analytically from frame and seed, without pointer input, photos, captions or tooltips.

name: Spotlight Card
mechanism: A pointer-positioned radial light illuminates a rounded card surface through CSS custom properties.
adaptation: An original clipped vector card carries a slowly orbiting radial light and highlight ring, with no simulated cursor or interactive state.

name: Pixel Card
mechanism: Canvas pixel cells animate in a grid with configurable spacing, speed, colors and variant behavior.
adaptation: An original seeded SVG cell array varies square dimensions in an ongoing radial wave; no live random stream, hover state or browser clock is retained.

name: Glass Surface
mechanism: Rounded glass surfaces use SVG displacement, color-channel offsets, blur, border thickness and light response.
adaptation: Three original translucent panes move across abstract stripes, whose shifted clipped geometry implies refraction; this is a vector interpretation, not a copied displacement shader.

name: Fluid Glass
mechanism: Three-dimensional glass lens, bar or cube modes refract surrounding content and respond to scrolling or pointer movement.
adaptation: An original breathing vector lens distorts a wordless wave field analytically, with no images, navigation labels, scrolling or external assets.

name: Stack
mechanism: A spring-animated stack of cards supports rotations and front-to-back changes through dragging, clicking or autoplay.
adaptation: An original blank-card fan has deterministic angle and offset breathing, preserving layered depth without photos, click targets or mutable ordering state.

name: Card Swap
mechanism: Offset, skewed cards cycle through dropping, promoting and returning phases with elastic or smooth easing.
adaptation: Three original abstract cards exchange projected depth on a continuous seeded orbit; ordering is derived directly from the addressed frame.

name: Bounce Cards
mechanism: A rotated image-card fan enters with staggered elastic scaling and optional hover transforms.
adaptation: Five original portrait-shaped blank panels use phased bounce and scale harmonics throughout the beat; geometric tokens replace all images.

name: Dock
mechanism: A horizontal dock magnifies nearby items according to pointer distance, using spring motion and a rounded panel.
adaptation: A travelling analytic focus enlarges wordless geometric tiles over an original tray; it has no toolbar behavior, app logos or pointer dependency.

name: Gooey Nav
mechanism: Active navigation transitions produce a gooey particle highlight with configurable particle distances, timing and colors.
adaptation: Original circle tokens connect to a moving blob through analytic curved necks and seeded orbiting dots, without labels, links or random particle creation.

name: Stepper
mechanism: Connected step indicators change state as a staged content panel moves backward, forward or completes.
adaptation: Original unlabeled circle tokens and a travelling geometric bead visualize connection rhythm, not actual task progress, user data or executable controls.

name: Folder
mechanism: A folder front opens while up to three paper items lift or fan with interactive offsets.
adaptation: An original tabbed folder silhouette opens and reveals three blank polygon sheets using seed-and-frame geometry, without files, titles or false evidence.

name: Elastic Slider
mechanism: A draggable slider uses elastic overflow and scale response, with optional stepped values and endpoint icons.
adaptation: An original curved tension rail follows an oscillating thumb with abstract endpoints; it shows no numeric value and accepts no user input.
